title: Regulating Gender Diversity: Evidence from California Senate Bill 826
authors: Abigail M. Allen; Aida Sijamic Wahid
eligible_reason: Single-date policy (California SB 826, one legislative event sequence) with no staggered adoption. Tables 2, 3, 5A are calendar-time portfolio and eventstudy2 abnormal-return event studies around SB 826 legislative dates (market-model regressions of ex_ret on ex_mktret and an event-day dummy); Table 4 and 5B are cross-sectional CARs on CaliforniaHQ x FemaleShortage with industry FE; Table 6 is a single-date DiD of board female share (pctFem on post, CaliforniaHQ, postXCA plus time-varying controls zlogat zNumberDirectors zbig3_perc, absorb(ff_17) only, no firm FE); Tables 8-9 compare female vs male appointees before/after (reg female post female_post). No unit-specific adoption dates and no shipped data.
design_notes: California-headquartered firms are treated by SB 826 (signed Sept 30, 2018); comparison = non-California firms. Time Series Data.dta: firm-period board composition; Cross Sectional Data.dta: firm-level CARs. All final datasets are built from licensed Compustat, CRSP, BoardEx, Thomson Reuters and Audit Analytics files via Dataprep.do.
estimators_reported: event-study abnormal returns (eventstudy2, WRDS Event Study)
single-date DiD with industry FE and controls (Table 6)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One policy (SB 826) applying to California HQ firms at a common date.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; industry FE instead of firm FE; time-varying controls; data not shipped
specs.controls: post CaliforniaHQ zbig3_perc postXbig3_perc zlogat zNumberDirectors
specs.notes: Col 2 adds triple interactions with Fem3.

data_files: Online_Appendix_Excel_Supplement.xlsx (legislative history, bill classification, press/Twitter coverage; no regression data)
data_files_note: Final datasets (cleandata.dta, Cross Sectional Data.dta, Time Series Data.dta, Director Appointments and Qualifications Data.dta, Appointment Returns Data.dta) are not included; README explains how to rebuild them from licensed WRDS data.
priority_note: Not eligible: single-date policy; no data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (readme.docx, mainresults.do, regression inventory). No article text available.
